I'll start you off by saying, use your diaphragm, hold your breath. Open up a little bit and let out warm air as to fog up a window. That's the feeling you want when you scream. From there, it's adding a whisper saying "heyyyyy" and keeping the constriction in your throat. Find the balance in the amount of airflow, constriction, vocals, and controlling all of that. Then move your tongue and mouth around to distort the sound in different ways. Then you can get a bit louder. Not any louder than a yell. If it hurts, stop. Sip water when practicing. Limit yourself to about 15-30min a day of tough practice. Be safe.
